preprocessing.missing: No imputation; require all frozen eligible months.
preprocessing.ridge: Training-row feature centering and population-standard-deviation scaling; unpenalized intercept.
preprocessing.sarima: Divide origin-known observations by their population standard deviation, or absolute level for a constant series.
preprocessing.surges: Preserve all signed observed values; no clipping, log transform or outlier removal.
